### What went into it

- **Design** — a custom color palette, typography choices, and layout decisions made entirely from scratch
- **Structure** — Quarto's publishing framework, configured for GitHub Pages with a custom domain
- **Styling** — a multi-file CSS/SCSS architecture: global styles, a hero stylesheet, and page-specific stylesheets for each major section
- **Content** — an editorial-style film review page, a full analytics case study with interactive visualizations, an interactive Flexdashboard, and a styled resume with a custom table of contents

### Tools Used

| Tool           | Purpose                               |
|----------------|---------------------------------------|
| Quarto         | Site framework & rendering            |
| CSS / SCSS     | Custom styling & Bootswatch overrides |
| HTML           | Custom components & page structure    |
| R              | Dashboard templating & rendering      |
| GitHub         | Version control & hosting             |
| Chart.js       | Interactive data visualizations       |
| Flexdashboard  | Analytics dashboard layout            |

    <div class="build-card-title">Deployment</div>
    <div class="build-card-body">Getting the site live involved more than clicking "publish." Connecting a custom domain, resolving Jekyll conflicts with Quarto's file structure, fixing broken CSS on the live site, and wrangling Git branch divergence — all sorted, all documented.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="build-card">
    <div class="build-card-icon">🎨</div>
    <div class="build-card-title">Design System</div>
    <div class="build-card-body">A deliberate six-color palette, a multi-file SCSS architecture, and custom font overrides on top of Bootswatch Minty. Every element — navbar, hero, buttons, headings — styled intentionally rather than inherited by default.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="build-card">
    <div class="build-card-icon">🧭</div>
    <div class="build-card-title">Navigation</div>
    <div class="build-card-body">Dropdown menus, left-justified links, custom font sizing and weight, a tooltip that appears on hover over this very page's nav link — the navbar alone required half a dozen targeted CSS fixes.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="build-card">
    <div class="build-card-icon">✍️</div>
    <div class="build-card-title">Editorial Writing Page</div>
    <div class="build-card-body">A film review converted into a full editorial layout: drop caps, pull quotes, a full-bleed hero image, floated mid-article photography, and a page-specific tan background — each with its own CSS variables and override logic.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="build-card">
    <div class="build-card-icon">📊</div>
    <div class="build-card-title">Analytics Case Study</div>
    <div class="build-card-body">A full project page featuring interactive Chart.js visualizations from GA4 data, stat cards, data tables, and an embedded 6-slide RevealJS presentation — plus a Flexdashboard with crosstalk-linked filters, scatter plots, and a correlation heatmap.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="build-card">
    <div class="build-card-icon">📄</div>
    <div class="build-card-title">Resume Page</div>
    <div class="build-card-body">Custom HTML tables, an auto-generated table of contents, SVG decorative dividers, targeted font overrides per section, and university seals sized with pixel-level precision — because markdown tables weren't going to cut it.</div>
